use_case: Automate CI/CD pipelines with AI-assisted code generation to build, test, and deploy software faster and more reliably.
Use Copilot Autofix to automatically identify and remediate security vulnerabilities in code during the development lifecycle.
Run automated security scans and enforce security policies as part of every CI/CD workflow to catch vulnerabilities before they reach production.
Launch cloud-based development environments pre-configured with Copilot so developers can start coding instantly from anywhere.
Link issues directly to project boards to track work, visualize roadmaps, and manage team tasks from planning through delivery.
Assign initial pull request reviews to Copilot to accelerate code review cycles and improve code quality before human review.
Automatically detect vulnerable dependencies and receive supported pull requests with fixes to keep the software supply chain secure.
Extend CI/CD workflows by installing pre-built actions and integrations from the Marketplace to customize the entire toolchain.
Detect, prevent, and remediate leaked secrets across an organization's repositories using push protection and secret scanning.
Manage projects, assign tasks to Copilot agents, and review AI-generated suggestions from a mobile device to maintain momentum on the go.
Trigger Copilot agents directly from GitHub Issues to autonomously plan, code, and submit pull requests resolving tracked work items.
Convert community discussions into actionable issues to seamlessly move from open-ended team conversation to tracked development work.
Pre-build Codespaces environments using Actions workflows so developers always get fast, ready-to-code cloud environments.
Connect Copilot to external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol to extend AI capabilities across the development workflow.
Automatically trigger code quality checks, linting, and tests when a pull request is opened to enforce standards before merging.
Automatically merge Dependabot dependency update pull requests using Actions workflows after CI checks pass, reducing maintenance overhead.
Fund open source maintainers whose tools and actions you rely on from the Marketplace to sustain the open source ecosystem.
Run CodeQL and secret scanning as part of every GitHub Actions workflow to continuously enforce security policies across all repositories.
Use Copilot to summarize long discussion threads and generate actionable next steps, keeping team knowledge organized alongside code.
Automatically update project board statuses and fields using Actions workflows triggered by pull request or issue lifecycle events.
Deploy enterprise-grade AI code assistance at scale with centralized policy controls, usage analytics, and security compliance for large organizations.
Block pull request merges automatically when code scanning finds critical vulnerabilities, enforcing security quality gates in CI/CD pipelines.
Trigger, monitor, and manage GitHub Actions workflows directly from the terminal to streamline developer automation without leaving the command line.
Open repositories from GitHub Desktop directly into a Codespaces environment, giving developers a seamless transition between local and cloud development.
Apply Copilot Autofix suggestions to security alerts raised by Advanced Security scanning, reducing mean time to remediate vulnerabilities.
Automate issue triage, labeling, and assignment workflows using Actions so teams can focus on building rather than manual project administration.
Install third-party security scanning tools from the Marketplace and integrate them into Advanced Security workflows for comprehensive application protection.
Assign project tasks and sub-issues to Copilot agents to autonomously implement work items, keeping project boards automatically up to date.
Publish versioned packages, container images, and artifacts directly to GitHub Packages as part of automated CI/CD release pipelines.
Automatically block commits containing exposed secrets using push protection and notify security teams via Actions-triggered alerts.
